knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Each product is dissolved and added separately. Mixing chemicals before they reach the water can produce fatal gas or an explosion.
Child safety comes first, and the adult takes charge. Unsafe storage is then dealt with using the safety data sheet and recorded.
The UK handbook describes rinsing and disposal. The Australian disposal route must be checked before it is applied.

practicalCriteria: Safety data sheet is read and referred to before any product is handled, with the protective equipment worn
Each product is dissolved alone in its own labelled bucket and added slowly, with the bucket washed in the pool
Products are returned to their own containers, and storage is observed to be locked, separated and away from the filter
A refusal to mix two products is given with the reason recorded
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of one supervised chemical addition
Referral note for any unsafe storage observed
stopWorkCriteria: Undissolved chemical added directly to the pool
Product used in a container for another product
Chemical handled with a child in the immediate area and no adult in charge
Chemical handled without the protective equipment the safety data sheet requires
